zh-CN.title: 年末来信
items: 圣诞聊天页头的右上角挂起红丝带、圆球与金星，下沿点亮错落的暖灯。
空间开启年度回顾后，可在菜单里拆开年末来信，回看这一年的聊天点滴。
普通群聊支持主动加入多人语音，永久 VIP 的私聊与群聊共享每周 30 分钟，群聊按个人参会时长扣除额度。
群聊也可以在聊天快捷操作里添加通话按钮。
桌面聊天使用折叠输入栏时，切换到其他操作会收起表情包面板。

en.title: A year-end letter
items: Christmas chat headers now have a red bow, bauble, and gold star in the corner, with warm fairy lights along the bottom.
Once your space opens its annual recap, open your year-end letter from the menu and revisit a year of conversations.
Join group voice calls from chat. Permanent VIPs share 30 minutes a week across direct and group calls, with group time counted per person.
Add Call to your group chat shortcuts.
The sticker picker now closes when switching tools in the compact desktop chat composer.
